text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The U.S. and British draft resolution to impose new sanctions against Iraq faces strong objection at the Security Council.
- Iranian heath minister visits Moslem holy shrine in Iraq's Kerbela and Najaf.
- Representatives of Canadian and Swiss firms discuss with Iraqi officials enhancing trade cooperation.
- Editorial condemning the U.S. and British draft resolution against Iraq.
(The above except the editorial were carried by JUMHOURIYA and QADISSIYA)
- Philippine companies express readiness to boost trade with Iraq.
- The visit of Iraqi economic team to Syria leads to positive results.
